{{Quote|<s></s>''Baron Nax Cirvan''. A jaded Jedi recruited by Count Dooku. He became a specter ''haunting'' the Outer Rim&hellip;appearing long enough to kill a Jedi general or wipe out a legion of clone troopers, and then vanishing again.|Lieutenant Laurita Tohm, in his reports on the events at the Prism|<ref name="Ghost Prison 4" />}}
[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] '''Nax Cirvan''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], formerly of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], who was recruited as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After rampaging through the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], Cirvan was finally apprehended by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after trying to kidnap [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] for Dooku. Incarcerated inside the secret [[Prison/Legends|prison]] called [[the Prism]] for his crimes, Cirvan spent the remainder of the war there. He was released in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] along with the rest of the prisoners by a trio of high-ranking members of the newborn [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Trachta]], and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Laurita Tohm]]. The three had escaped from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] along with a wounded [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], seeking refuge on the Prism from a [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]] [[Military revolt on Coruscant|orchestrated]] by [[Gentis]], the [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. Vader&mdash;who used to be Cirvan's captor, Anakin Skywalker&mdash;[[Mission to the Prism|pitted]] the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] against each other in a free-for-all battle to recruit the best fighters to his cause. Cirvan survived the brawl and pledged his allegiance to the Empire after being promised amnesty for his crimes. The Dark Jedi helped Vader [[Battle on Coruscant|retake]] Coruscant, but was betrayed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] when the [[Unidentified transport (Prism convicts)|transport]] he and the other prisoners were given to leave Coruscant exploded.

==Biography==
===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Your blade does not frighten me&mdash;I killed eight Jedi&mdash;and their Padawans&mdash;on the plains of Rullag.|Nax Cirvan|<ref name="Ghost Prison 4" />}}
Nax Cirvan, a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], however, Cirvan fell from the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi path]] and embraced the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], becoming a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. He was recruited as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Republic's enemy in the war. Taking up the title of [[Baron/Legends|baron]], Cirvan created a name for himself by attacking Republic targets in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], quickly wiping out a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] or [[Death/Legends|slaying]] a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]], and then disappearing once again. At one point, he claimed to have killed eight [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] on the plains of [[Rullag]]. Dooku then tasked Cirvan with kidnapping [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]], a task that gained the attention of famed [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who finally tracked Cirvan down. During their fight, Skywalker beat Cirvan senseless and then had him incarcerated in [[the Prism]], a secret Jedi [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility, alongside other deadly combatants of the war.<ref name="Ghost Prison 4" />

===Service to the Empire===
{{Quote|I do not know who you are or why you have come here, but I do know that if I defeat ''you'' the prisoners will crown ''me'' to lead them.|Nax Cirvan, to Darth Vader|<ref name="Ghost Prison 4" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Jedi Order and the Republic both ceased to exist thanks to the machinations of the newly-crowned [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], with the former destroyed and the latter reorganized into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Ghost Prison 1">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 1|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 1]]</ref> Shortly thereafter, however, [[Gentis]], the [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] of [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], orchestrated a [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]], hoping to kill the Emperor, end the Empire's warmongering ways, and prevent more of Gentis's soldiers from dying on the battlefields.<ref name="Ghost Prison 2">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 2|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 2]]</ref> Palpatine was indeed gravely wounded in the [[Military revolt on Coruscant|attacks]], but he was saved by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Trachta]], and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Laurita Tohm]]. The trio evacuated Palpatine from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and brought him to the Prism, knowing it to be one location where Gentis's men would never find them. While the Emperor was attended to by the facility's [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], Tohm devised a plan to take back Coruscant by releasing the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] to create a small army. Vader, however, instead had all 207 of the prisoners, including Cirvan, [[Mission to the Prism|released]] into the prison yard with orders to kill anyone they could, Tohm and Vader included, in an attempt to filter out the best fighters among of the convicts.<ref name="Ghost Prison 3">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 3|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 3]]</ref>

The ensuing fighting was brutal and indiscriminate. In the midst of it, Cirvan saw Vader battle a multitude of adversaries, striking them all down with ease. Unaware that Vader used to be his captor, Anakin Skywalker, who had turned to the dark side as well, Cirvan isolated the Dark Lord as the most powerful combatant and hoped to dispatch the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] so that the rest of the prisoners crowned him as their leader. The Dark Jedi first used his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] to attack Vader, [[Telekinesis/Legends|barraging]] him with rubble and blasts of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Closing the distance, Cirvan used the Force to [[Force jump/Legends|jump]] over the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. However, Vader grabbed Cirvan's long braids in mid-air and slammed him into the ground, putting his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to the baron's throat. Recognizing Vader's power and position, Cirvan yielded, and Vader let him live, calling a halt to the battle. In the end, only thirty-three prisoners survived the riot in fighting condition, and were told by Trachta what it meant to serve the Empire. Cirvan and the others were promised that their crimes were now forgotten, but they would now serve the Empire in return. Cirvan followed the example of the other prisoners and knelt before Trachta, accepting the deal.<ref name="Ghost Prison 4" />

[[File:Cirvan_fighting.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Cirvan fighting alongside his new Imperial allies to liberate Coruscant]]
Launching their campaign to retake Coruscant from Gentis, Tohm and one of the surviving prisoners, [[Shonn Volta]], triangulated the course of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]],<ref name="Ghost Prison 5" /> who, after Palpatine was presumed dead, was heading to Coruscant to assume control of the Empire as its highest ranking [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]].<ref name="Ghost Prison 3" /> Cirvan and the rest of the ex-prisoners, as well as Vader, Trachta, Tohm, and the recovering Emperor, intercepted Tarkin's shuttle mid-flight and secured the Grand Moff's support. Hiding themselves inside the shuttle, the strike team arrived on Coruscant and sprang a trap upon Gentis and his cadets. When Gentis attempted to take the Grand Moff prisoner as the final part in his coup, Cirvan and the rest of the strike team emerged from the shuttle and [[Battle on Coruscant|attacked]] the traitorous Headmaster's forces, supported only by a few loyal [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that escorted Tarkin. The battle was over within moments, with the prisoners' advanced combat expertise overwhelming the far greater numbers of Gentis's followers. The Emperor himself, recovered from his ailments, attacked and killed Gentis with Force lightning.<ref name="Ghost Prison 5" />

Cirvan survived the battle and celebrated among the other prisoners. Unknown to Cirvan and the others, however, the Imperials that they had fought beside were at that moment trying to determine their fates. Trachta believed that they owed the prisoners a debt of gratitude and that they should honor their promises to them. Vader thought that they should all be executed to prevent them from becoming enemies in the future. Tohm proposed a third option, and the prisoners were told they would be set free but that they had to [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] themselves to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Before they left, they were met by Trachta, Tohm, and Vader at the landing pad where a [[Unidentified transport (Prism convicts)|transport]] awaited them, and the details of their release were once more outlined. Cirvan agreed to all of the parts of the deal, and Trachta wished him luck. As the ship ascended over the Coruscant cityscape, it detonated, killing Cirvan and all those aboard. Tohm and Vader had betrayed the agreement, unbeknownst to Trachta, who was horrified by the dishonorable massacre.<ref name="Ghost Prison 5" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|By my estimates, Gentis had us outnumbered at least eight to one. But Gentis did not have a Sith Lord in his ranks. Or a bitter exiled Jedi|Lieutenant Laurita Tohm, referring to Cirvan in his report on the final battle of the Ghost Prison incident|<ref name="Ghost Prison 5" />}}
A tall, powerfully built humanoid male, by the time of his release from the Prism, Cirvan had long, black hair, styled in long braids, as well as a number of black markings covering his body. He also had light skin and eye color. Described as bitter<ref name="Ghost Prison 5" /> and jaded by Lieutenant Tohm, Cirvan abandoned the Jedi teachings and was swayed by the dark side. During his tenure as Count Dooku's hitman, Cirvan established a reputation of a ruthless assassin, who had no second thoughts at slaying Jedi Padawans or kidnapping Force-sensitive children. Cirvan was not devoid of ambition, which he demonstrated during the Prism riot when he attempted to kill Vader and claim leadership over the rest of the prisoners. However, he had enough sense of self-preservation to admit his defeat and swear his allegiance to the Empire.<ref name="Ghost Prison 4" />

==Powers and abilities==
Trained as a Jedi, Cirvan was adept at using the Force, displaying his talents for telekinesis and ability to Force jump during the Prism riot. As a [[darksider]], he also learned to conjure Force lightning.<ref name="Ghost Prison 4" /> He was proficient with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] while wielding a lightsaber at the same time, which he used during the retaking of Coruscant.<ref name="Ghost Prison 5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nax Cirvan was created by [[W. Haden Blackman]] for the [[2012]] [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]''. He appeared in the final two issues of the series and was drawn by [[Agustin Alessio]]. Cirvan's [[Species/Legends|species]] was never identified in the comic books, and despite him looking mostly [[Human/Legends|Human]] in appearance, his facial features were drawn noticeably different from an average Human.<ref name="Ghost Prison 5" /><ref name="Ghost Prison 4" />
